PLAN YOUR BEACH DAY AT
2 PRIVATE DESTINATIONS

Every weekend cruise onboard Wonder of the Seas® includes an action-packed stop at one or both of our must-see private destinations. Pump up the adrenaline at the award-winning Perfect Day CocoCay and conquer Daredevil’s Peak®, the tallest waterslide in the Caribbean. And grab a day pass to the all-new Royal Beach Club℠ Paradise Island and experience two pristine beaches and three pools at the biggest beach bash in Nassau.

ESCAPE THE EVERYDAY
WITH FRIENDS AND FAMILY

You've never weekended like this before — with more onboard to see, do, play and conquer. Lounge on the resort-style pool deck, get your adrenaline pumping on the Ultimate Abyss℠ and dance the night away at one of the rave-worthy parties onboard.

PLAY ALL DAY ADVENTURES

Swap your ordinary weekend plans for all-out thrills on Wonder of the Seas®. Tee off at Wonder Dunes, where kids can navigate an undersea mini golf course, while couples can challenge each other on the Perfect Storm℠ slides or conquer the Ultimate Abyss℠. Whether racing, relaxing, or exploring, there's excitement for everyone aboard.

THE ULTIMATE KICK BACK

Escape the hustle and find your perfect weekend retreat. Teens can hang out in their exclusive space, Social100, where gaming, music, and movies await. The patio features lawn games, a juice bar, and a whirlpool to unwind under the sun or stars. Meanwhile, couples can relax in the adults-only Solarium, indulge in rejuvenating massages at Vitality℠ Spa, and enjoy panoramic views at Vue Bar℠.

DATE NIGHT DELIGHTS

When the sun goes down on Wonder of the Seas®, the party’s just getting started. Kick off the evening with a striking show at the AquaTheater. Then sing along to your favorite tunes at Spotlight Karaoke before heading out to one of the adults-only parties onboard.

WHAT TO KNOW
BEFORE YOU GO
Wonder of the Seas® is Florida’s best family vacation.

From endless onboard thrills to gourmet globetrotting and top-notch shows, Wonder of the Seas® surprises with thrills and wow-worthy experiences at every turn. Like The Perfect Storm℠ waterslide trio and a zip line 10 decks high. Or Splashaway Bay℠ aqua park, where kids have gallons of fun. And with over 20 mouthwatering dining options, it’s easy to treat yourself to a delicious globetrotting adventure. Plus when it comes to showstopping entertainment, Wonder of the Seas® dazzles with shows that transcend air and water. Take a peek at our guides to discover all the adventures that await you onboard.

    Privacy Preference Center

    When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences, or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect. The information does not usually identify you directly, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to learn more and change our default settings. Blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
    More information

    Manage Consent Preferences

    Required Cookies

    Always Active

    Required Cookies are necessary to the operation of certain of Our Digital Platforms. These Cookies are generally set in response to your use of the platform, including requests for services made by you through the website, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging into your accounts, and/or completing fields/forms, etc. Required Cookies may not be blocked through Our Digital Platforms. You may, however, set your browser to block and/or report these Cookies; any such blocking, including refusing to accept a request to place a Cookie, may affect the operation of Our Digital Platforms.

    • Functional Cookies
      Always Active

      Functional Cookies may be set by Us and/or third parties to add enhanced functionality to certain of Our Digital Platforms such as recognizing you when you return to Our Digital Platforms and remembering your choice of language. If these Cookies are disabled, access will be limited to such functionality(ies).

    Performance Cookies

    Always Active

    Performance Cookies may be set by Us and/or third parties to monitor the performance of Our Digital Platforms. These Cookies permit us to measure and improve the performance of Our websites, including an understanding of which areas of a platform are most popular and how users arrive to and navigate around the platform. For example, which of Our webpages are most popular and how users get to certain webpages.

    Do Not Sell My Information

    Always Active

    Do Not Sell My Information

    • Advertising Cookies
      Always Active

      Advertising Cookies may be set by Us and/or third parties to enable the delivery of more relevant advertisements, including on third party websites. These Cookies are able to build a profile of your interests by tracking your activities across Our Digital Platforms and those of others, including websites. If these Cookies are disabled, you will receive less targeted advertising.
